source: scenario: placeholder values for the pre-boot prediction, NOT measurements

notes.b_in: audit M512 logical replayed bytes / kernel time gave 173-194 GB/s; used only as a scenario value
notes.F_direct_G_launch: chosen so 8 serialized launches reproduce the 590-770 us small-shape floor seen in P1/P2; unmeasured
notes.a2a_allgather: scenario latency and bandwidth for 8-GPU NVSwitch collectives; unmeasured
notes.F_staged: unmeasured; set equal to F_direct so the pre-boot scenario does not favour either path (both run in one harness and synchronise 8 GPUs)
notes.check: reproduces P1 M512 within +13..23% (q4/g1 1809 vs 1607 us, q4/g2 1172 vs 953 us) and the 590-770 us small-shape floor; not fitted
